The '''Sisk system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sisk/Legends|Sisk]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
